150
der Landes Altesten v. Lichnowski: schreibt d. d. 23. Nov. 1804.
an Sr durchl:
daß er seit anderthalb Jahren vom 4 May 1803. bis 4 Nov. a. c.
einen Zins Rükstand von 5572 rthl. 12. gg. an Sr Durchl. habe zu
fordern, er hätte geglaubt, daß da Trąbczyn, admiuhträt
wurde er zu s. Zahlung gelangen würde, er habe deshalb ein
Mandat bey Kalischer Regierung bewirkt, welches Sr. d. binnen 14
Tagen die Zahlung auflegt, wundert sich aber, daß diese ver¬
strichen und er nichts erhalten habe. Er droht mit Antrag auf
sequestration will abwägerne Sr. durchl. Verdruß erspa¬
ren und wünscht fernerhin in gutem Vernehmen zu stehen
und glaubt daß die Weihnachten Selittel bringen wurden
ihr zu befriedigen.
Antwort.
die Pächter hätten nicht gezahlt — er würde befriedigt werden, da
Herr v. Triebenfeld dort alles in Ordnung und ins Reine bräch¬
 ta. — d. 27ten Nov. 1804

translation.en:
150. The provincial elder von Lichnowski writes, dated 23 November 1804, to His Serene Highness:

that for a year and a half, from 4 May 1803 to 4 November of the current year, he has an arrear of interest of 5572 Rthl 12 Groschen to demand of His Serene Highness; he had believed that, since Trąbczyn was [uncertain: administered], he would obtain his payment; he had therefore procured a mandate from the Kalisz government which imposes payment upon His Serene Highness within 14 days, but he is astonished that these have elapsed and that he has received nothing. He threatens an application for sequestration, but would gladly spare His Serene Highness vexation, and wishes to continue on good terms, and believes that Christmas would bring the means to satisfy [uncertain: him].

Reply.

the tenants had not paid — he would be satisfied, since Mr von Triebenfeld was putting everything there in order and setting it straight. — 27 November 1804

text_english:
150. The provincial elder von Lichnowski writes, dated 23 November 1804, to His Serene Highness:

that for a year and a half, from 4 May 1803 to 4 November of the current year, he has an arrear of interest of 5572 Rthl 12 Groschen to demand of His Serene Highness; he had believed that, since Trąbczyn was [uncertain: administered], he would obtain his payment; he had therefore procured a mandate from the Kalisz government which imposes payment upon His Serene Highness within 14 days, but he is astonished that these have elapsed and that he has received nothing. He threatens an application for sequestration, but would gladly spare His Serene Highness vexation, and wishes to continue on good terms, and believes that Christmas would bring the means to satisfy [uncertain: him].

Reply.

the tenants had not paid — he would be satisfied, since Mr von Triebenfeld was putting everything there in order and setting it straight. — 27 November 1804
summary_en: Extract from the files: in a letter of 23 November 1804 the Senior Land Councillor von Lichnowski demands from the Prince arrears of interest of 5572 Rthl 12 gg for one and a half years (4 May 1803 to 4 November). An order of the Kalisz government set a payment deadline of 14 days, which has passed without payment. He threatens to apply for sequestration, but hopes for good relations. The reply is that the tenants have not paid; he will be satisfied, since Mr von Triebenfeld is putting everything in order.
summary_de: Aktenauszug: Landesältester v. Lichnowski fordert mit Schreiben vom 23. Nov. 1804 vom Fürsten einen Zinsrückstand von 5572 Rthl 12 gg für anderthalb Jahre (4. Mai 1803 bis 4. Nov.). Ein Mandat der Kalischer Regierung setzte eine Zahlungsfrist von 14 Tagen, die ohne Zahlung verstrichen ist. Er droht mit einem Antrag auf Sequestration, wünscht aber gutes Einvernehmen. Die Antwort lautet, die Pächter hätten nicht gezahlt. Er werde befriedigt werden, da Herr v. Triebenfeld alles in Ordnung bringe.

reading.notes: This is a file note, not a letter. It abstracts a letter from Landesältester v. Lichnowski dated 23 Nov 1804 to the Prince (Sr Durchl.). Lichnowski claims 5572 rthl 12 gg of arrears on interest covering 4 May 1803 to 4 Nov. He obtained a mandate from the Kalisz government requiring payment within 14 days. That deadline has passed, so he threatens to apply for sequestration, though he hopes to stay on good terms and expects funds by Christmas. The draft answer, dated 27 Nov 1804, says the tenants have not paid and that he will be satisfied once Triebenfeld has put things in order. Line 6 'admiuhträt' is garbled (probably 'administrirt'). Line 11 'abwägerne' is probably 'aber gerne' and line 13 'Selittel' probably 'Mittel'.
